text:
marta: Heads up — staging GPU pool started failing node joins after the new VPC IAM condition landed this morning. Nodes get past boot but fail during keystore decrypt, looks like KMS denies.

devin: ugh. saw a spike in keystore errors earlier. any logs?

marta: pasted the relevant line from journal: 
```
2026-03-23T09:12:03Z ERROR keystore: decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: user arn:aws:sts::...:assumed-role/gpu-node/... is not allowed by condition `aws:SourceVpc`
```

raj: that matches the new conditional policy change we pushed for privnet isolation (restricting KMS grants to specific VPCs). We scoped down the grant to prevent audit leak to one project.

lucy: we expected to whitelist the warm-pool subnets, did the list include staging warm pool?

devin: Nope, staging pool had a leftover subnet id. I can roll a quick allowlist update but need approval for expanding the grant scope.

ops-oncall: tagging ops — this is blocking any fresh GPU capacity in staging which is affecting benchmark runs. Can we do an emergency fallback?

marta: Can we fallback to kms-key-policy toggling to allow STS role from the node join service? Short-term mitigation.

raj: two options: 1) widen the grant condition to include staging VPC; 2) add exception for the node-assume-role principal. Option 1 is faster but slightly broader.

lucy: Option 1 will temporarily increase audit surface — compliance will flag it but we can attach an explicit logshipper filter. Option 2 is more surgical but needs IAM review and might be slower.

devin: propose do 1) for 30m window, then rotate to 2) with an RL for the IAM PR. I can open the PR and the KB update.

marta: ok do it but require an audit tag on the grant explaining justification and TTL. auditbot: please create an evidence ticket.

auditbot: Created ticket A-2026-78: "staging keystore KMS grant temporary widen for node join" and attached recent error logs.

ops-oncall: FYI cost note — wider grants may allow some cross-VPC access patterns we thought were blocked; watch for increased S3 shipper or audit exporter egress. Could hit NAT/Egress quotas.

raj: noted. we'll also add an egress sampling rule on the audit shipper to keep ingestion bounded.

devin: rolling the immediate allowlist now: patch applied to KMS grant condition to include vpc-0staging; will monitor joins.

marta: joins are succeeding again. running a smoke run on model-serving.

lucy: opening the follow-up IAM PR to add the node-assume-role exception and tighten subnet list. tagging sec-review. PR: https://git.company/repo/iam/pull/421

devin: leaving a temp TTL of 25m in the grant justification. removing after PR merges.

marta: thanks. action items: devin remove temp widen after 25m, lucy shepherd IAM PR, raj add auditshipper sample filter, ops-oncall monitor NAT qps.

ops-oncall: ack. I'll watch NAT metrics & raise if ingress/e2e cost increases. :eyes:

marta: closing thread once PR merged and temp grant removed. thanks all. :thumbsup:
